financial_series_method.delta_nwc_basis: Cash-flow-statement reconciliation basis: delta_nwc = -(cfs working-capital cash inflow) - change in current income tax liabilities. The balance-sheet direct change is NOT used, because the 2015 to 2016 reclassification of customer deposits (RMB 54,108m, FY2016 report note 38) and the simultaneous disappearance of restricted cash (RMB 54,731m at 2015 year-end to RMB 750m at 2016 year-end) is a non-cash presentation change; the balance-sheet basis would misstate 2016 delta_nwc as +29,491 and FCFF_2016 as about 4,900.
financial_series_method.fintech_classification: Financial technology and enterprise services are pre-classified as core operating business; they are not classified as non-operating assets and are not separately added in SOTP.
financial_series_method.fx: All financial_series and SOTP amounts are recorded in the annual reports reporting currency (CNY, RMB million). Conversion to HKD is pending; the CFETS fiscal-year-end HKD/CNY mid-rate working assumption is not yet finalised and no rate has been taken. No HKD amounts are recorded in this pass.
financial_series_method.listed_equity_market_value_sensitivity: Not computable from the annual reports alone (no per-holding share counts or formation-date closing prices disclosed); recorded as a gap and not estimated.

sotp.fx_note: Amounts are in RMB as reported; conversion to HKD is pending (CFETS fiscal-year-end HKD/CNY mid-rate working assumption not yet finalised; no rate taken). model_inputs.non_operating_value_per_share remains null until conversion is decided.
sotp.listed_equity_market_value_sensitivity: Not computable from annual reports alone: the balance sheet does not disclose per-holding share counts and formation-date closing prices for listed equity investments; recorded as a gap, not estimated, and not written back to the main SOTP input.
sotp.duplicate_counting_check: Interest income, dividend income, disposal gains and fair-value gains on other financial assets were removed from EBIT; investee impairment was added back; share of associates and joint ventures profit is below operating profit and not in EBIT; available-for-sale fair-value movements go through other comprehensive income, not profit or loss.
sotp.sources: FY2016 annual report balance sheet pp.112-113; borrowings and notes payable per the borrowings notes; lease liabilities 0: no finance lease liabilities in the borrowings note; operating lease commitments are off-balance-sheet under IAS 17 and are not deducted.
sotp.notes: Operating lease commitments (off-balance-sheet, IAS 17) at 2016 year-end 2,090 are not deducted. Long-term payables (content authorisation etc.) are not interest-bearing debt and are excluded from debt.
